```sql
SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Location, COUNT(*) as adoption_count
FROM posts a
JOIN posts q ON a.ParentId = q.Id
JOIN users u ON a.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE a.PostTypeId = 2
  AND q.PostTypeId = 1
  AND q.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.CreaionDate) = 2013
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM q.CreaionDate) = 6
GROUP BY a.OwnerUserId, u.DisplayName, u.Location
ORDER BY adoption_count DESC
LIMIT 10
```
